subject.title: feat(queue): state-append window endpoints for single-writer materialization (#738 WP-1)

question: Should the state-append, drain, and acknowledgement protocol in this PR become the accepted staged contract for the single-writer materialization plan in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/738 before the materializer is implemented?
rationale: The limits, record kinds, lease duration, and shedding response become a durable contract for later writer cutover work; tests can validate implementation but cannot choose the intended operational interface.

options.title: Accept WP-1 as the staged contract
options.body: Approve this bounded protocol as the RFC’s first implementation step, contingent on adding redacted live worker-path proof before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract first
options.body: Specify different record kinds, lease, capacity, or backpressure semantics in the RFC before landing a persisted endpoint contract.

options.title: Pause for the materializer design
options.body: Defer WP-1 until the planned materializer can validate the exact drain and acknowledgement contract end to end.

recommendation.title: Accept WP-1 as the staged contract
recommendation.body: Approve this bounded protocol as the RFC’s first implementation step, contingent on adding redacted live worker-path proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked RFC and the proposed WP-1 implementation, making them the clearest available routing candidate for the design discussion.
